skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the basic contents of responsible tourism development including responsible business management, accommodation, food service, and responsible tourism management.
Understand and analyze the basic contents of relevant laws and charters related to ethics and social responsibility of all parties involved in tourism and hospitality activities.
Clearly understand the issues of business ethics such as role, necessity, standards, and methods of building business ethics under the conditions of the tourism and hospitality industry.
Analyze environmental impacts and develop responsible tourism programs suitable for businesses.

Have a sense of responsibility to protect the environment and cultural values of the nation and humanity, with a positive attitude towards building ethical standards and social responsibility for individuals and organizations.

Be serious about studying and developing a career; be proactive in learning and self-improvement: have a responsible work attitude, honesty, seriousness, high discipline; have courteous, elegant, proper manners; be enthusiastic, love your job, and have a serving spirit.
Respect traditional culture, customs, and traditions, and be aware of preserving and promoting traditional cultural values.
Have a positive and proactive attitude in building ethical standards and social responsibility for individuals and organizations.
